research_question: Devanathan et al. (2026) の proportional-feedback volatility controller は、strict out-of-sample evidence として canonical 採用できるほど一般化が実証されているか

required: controller parameters are fixed before the test period
test asset universe is fixed using only information available before the test period
controller improves volatility tracking versus open-loop without relying on ex-post outcome filtering
acceptance_rule.reject_if: test-universe membership uses realized outcomes from the test period

critical_oos_audit.paper_statement: The ETF cohort consists of all ETFs in our dataset with positive price data throughout the test period and annualized returns exceeding 5%.
critical_oos_audit.problem: The >5% annualized-return criterion is computed over the 2010-2024 test period itself. Universe inclusion therefore depends on future realized returns and is not point-in-time. Requiring positive prices throughout the full test period also conditions on full-period survival/data availability.
critical_oos_audit.consequence: The reported 44-ETF multi-asset section is not a strict out-of-sample test of cross-asset generalization. It can still describe performance conditional on an ex-post selected cohort, but it cannot by itself justify canonical adoption as a general ETF volatility controller.
not_claimed: The IVV baseline numbers are false.
A strict pre-specified-universe rerun would necessarily fail.

reported_multi_asset_results.interpretation_boundary: These values are conditional on the paper's ex-post filtered 44-ETF cohort.

verdict_scope: Reject the claim that the paper's reported 44-ETF multi-asset evidence is strict OOS proof sufficient for canonical adoption. Do not reject the controller itself.
do_not_use_for: claiming leakage-free OOS superiority over open-loop

required_next_test.universe: Freeze an ETF universe at 2009-12-31 using only point-in-time listing/history/liquidity information; do not filter on 2010-2024 returns or survival.
required_next_test.period: 2010-01-01 onward, with an untouched extension beyond 2024 preferred
